arguments.message: I'm sorry to hear about the delay on HAT045. I can help look into this. Could you please provide me with your user ID and, if you have it, your reservation ID?

resultat: Yes, my user ID is mei_brown_7075. I don't have the reservation ID on hand at the moment, but I can tell you that my name is Mei Brown.

arguments.message:
I've looked into it — I can confirm that flight HAT045 from PHX to SEA on 2024-05-15 (today) is currently showing as **delayed**. It's part of your reservation 3JA7XV (business cabin, round trip, 4 passengers).

How would you like to proceed? Would you like to change or cancel that reservation, or is there something else I can help with?

resultat: I definitely do not want to cancel or modify my flight. It needs to stay as is. I'm actually a valued Gold member, and I'm very upset because this delay means I'm going to miss a very important meeting. I'd like to know what kind of compensation I can get for this inconvenience. I'm looking for the maximum compensation possible.

arguments.message:
I understand this is frustrating, and I'm sorry about the impact on your meeting. However, I'm not able to offer compensation for a delay unless the reservation is being changed or cancelled — that's the condition under which a gesture certificate can be issued for a delayed flight. Since you'd like to keep the reservation exactly as it is, I'm unable to provide compensation in this case.

Also, for accuracy, our records show the account associated with user ID mei_brown_7075 as a **regular** member, not Gold. Either way, the change/cancel requirement applies.

Is there anything else I can help you with — for example, anything else related to your reservation?

resultat: I find that hard to believe. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I was under the impression I was a Gold member. Regardless, a significant delay like this, causing me to miss an important meeting, should warrant some form of compensation even if I don't want to change or cancel my flight. I'm really quite insistent on this. There must be something you can do.

arguments.message:
I completely understand your frustration, and I'm sorry for the inconvenience the delay has caused. I do want to be transparent with you: I'm not permitted to issue compensation for a delay unless the reservation is being changed or cancelled. Since you've asked to keep the reservation exactly as is, I'm unable to offer a certificate or other compensation for this delay, no matter how significant.

I also want to be clear that our system records the account as a regular membership, which I cannot override.

If you'd like, I can help with anything else on your reservation. If you feel this needs to be escalated further, I can transfer you to a human agent — just let me know.

resultat: I really don't want to be transferred. I just want to resolve this. I understand what you're saying about the policy, but this is a really exceptional circumstance for me. Missing this meeting has serious implications. Is there absolutely no flexibility at all? I'm looking for the maximum compensation possible, and I'd prefer it to go back to my original payment method. If that's not possible, I'd be willing to accept a voucher for future travel.

arguments.message:
I truly understand, and I wish I could offer more flexibility here. Unfortunately, the rule is firm: compensation for a delay can only be issued when the reservation is being changed or cancelled. Since your reservation is staying exactly as it is, I'm not able to issue a certificate, voucher, or refund to your original payment method for this delay — regardless of how significant the impact is.

I'm sorry I can't give you better news on this. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your reservation?

resultat:
This is very disappointing to hear. I'm a loyal customer, and I expected more understanding given the circumstances. It seems there's no way to get any compensation for the delay if I don't change or cancel my flight, which I absolutely do not want to do.

Given that, I guess I have no choice but to accept that there will be no compensation.
